provider_organization: Maastricht University, with the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science
eligible_nationalities: All non-EU/EEA countries (not Switzerland or Suriname; no EU/EEA or Swiss dual nationality)

stipend.notes: Living expenses: EUR 20,150 for a one-year master's (13 months) or EUR 38,750 for a two-year master's (25 months)

application_fee.notes: Any master's application handling fee must be paid by 10 Dec 2026; amount not stated on the scholarship page. Air tickets and a EUR 75 housing cleaning fee are not covered.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: GPA of at least 7.5 out of 10 on your latest transcript (or equivalent)

required_documents.name: Official transcript
required_documents.detail: Showing GPA of 7.5 or higher, with an explanation of the grading system

required_documents.name: One reference letter
required_documents.detail: From a (former) professor, lecturer or employer, dated February 2026 or later; you upload it yourself

required_documents.name: Referee contact details
required_documents.detail: Work phone number and institutional email

preparation_alerts: Your master's application and complete file must be in by 10 Dec 2026, before the scholarship form deadline
Only one scholarship application, for one scholarship, is allowed
Preference goes to applicants who do not already have a master's

criteria.criterion: Faculty selection and ranking (top 5 per faculty)

selection_criteria.pass_rule: 18 scholarships a year (about 2% of applicants); status in April, final by early May 2027

source_urls.title: Maastricht University: NL-High Potential scholarship 2027-2028
source_urls.used_for: All eligibility, amounts, deadlines, documents and selection

verification_status.verification_notes: Official page: scholarship applications 1 Oct 2026 to 1 Feb 2027 23:59 CET, but the master's application with a complete file is due 10 Dec 2026, so deadline_date is the earlier date. min_grade_percent 75 comes from the stated 7.5/10 GPA. The lead called it 'UM Holland-High Potential'; the current name is NL-High Potential. The 2022 tweet's 'up to 30K' is outdated. English requirements are set by each master's programme (not read).
